items.title: Over a flat finitely presentable target map, relative pseudo-coherence is ordinary pseudo-coherence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat locally of finite presentation between spaces over S and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the lemma says E is pseudo-coherent relative to Y iff E is pseudo-coherent on X — the relativity is moot in the flat finitely presented situation. The retained proof is written: by etale localization on X and Y (the definitions of both notions are etale-local on source and target, the chapter's standing dictionary) reduce to schemes; the schemes statement is the More on Morphisms charts theorem (lemma check-relative-pseudo-coherence-on-charts — the closed-into-smooth-chart dictionary, collected schemes-side as L16132), applied to the identity chart X -> X over itself: relative-to-X pseudo-coherence of E coincides with absolute pseudo-coherence because O_X is flat finitely presented over itself. Retained author proof at lines 10871-10876.
